summaryZh: .11 的 macOS 取消作业在同一 tag/source 上重跑后成功，Windows 与 macOS 安装器、校验文件和两份 provenance 均已公开。包含插件管理服务的激活修复；两平台各 819 个 Kotlin 测试通过。后续 HTTP 执行和支持文件功能尚不在这一版中。

independentPublishedAssetAudit.installerAuthority: GitHub API sha256 digest, published SHA256SUMS, provenance installer size/digest, and successful producer publish-job pre-publication size/digest verification

windows.scope: Real installer bytes, native version and visible project-frame startup, explicit installed bundled tools and one uncached Go test via engine RPC; not interactive editor parity or Kotlin default-resolver acceptance.

macos.scope: Actual DMG mount/install copy, signatures, native launcher version, bundled SDK/tools and one uncached pure-Go test. Interactive GUI and clean-OS debugging require separate evidence.

contentBoundary: Includes the PluginManagementPolicy activation repair as well as the terminal chooser/Windows line-clear changes from .10.
Does not include later Go Template/SQL/Dockerfile/HTTP file types or built-in HTTP execution.
Native Windows interactive plugin/Chinese UI/terminal acceptance and macOS Developer Mode debugging remain open.
A later .12 Windows build hit a readiness-file sharing violation before owner startup; this .11 run succeeded. The test-handshake repair is in new source, outside this release.
Windows installer is not publisher-signed; macOS app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized.
Complete GoLand feature parity remains open.
